costShape.label: How the cost is shared in a group
costShape.perUnitHint: Each participant needs her own, like a flight or a meal.
costShape.sharedHint: One cost for the whole group. The more people join, the less each pays. A guide, for example.
costShape.steppedHint: Another unit for every {{capacity}} participants, like a bus or a room.

departure.linesTitle: What the price is made of
departure.note: You don't sign a price here. The price moves with the size of the group, and every rise comes with a notice. Until the price locks you can leave at any moment, with a full refund. It never goes above the ceiling without your explicit consent.
departure.noProducts: Your rikmas have no active composed product yet.
departure.priceDerived: The price comes from the product: the cost divided by the number of participants, plus the rikma's margin. There is no price to type.
departure.curveTitle: Price per participant by group size
departure.riseWarn: Participant {{count}} raises the price for everyone. Consider setting the maximum at a step boundary.
departure.consentTitle: The price passed the ceiling you saw when you joined
departure.consentBody: To stay, confirm by {{date}}. Without a yes you leave — not charged, with a full refund.
